headline: Gyftr shares jump 14.5% ahead of Q2 results announcement
hook: Market reacts to Gyftr's upcoming earnings date
summary: Shares of digital gift card provider Gyftr rose 14.5% following the company's announcement of a board meeting date to declare its Q2 2026 financial results. The price surge reflects market anticipation surrounding the upcoming earnings report. Retail investors should note that such volatility is common ahead of scheduled corporate disclosures.
whats_next: Board meeting to declare Q2 2026 results
why_it_matters: Earnings announcements often trigger significant short-term stock price volatility.
